instruction: Draft a reply to Marco saying we can't do 20% off, but don't send it. I want to read it first.
final_text:
I drafted a reply to Marco Bianchi in the "Renewal pricing" thread. It's saved in your Gmail drafts and hasn't been sent.

On 28 September, Marco asked for 20% off if Verdant commits to two years. The draft says:

> Hi Marco,
>
> Thanks for getting back to me, and I'm glad you're thinking about a two-year commitment.
>
> Unfortunately we can't offer 20% off. I'm happy to talk through what we can do on a two-year term, though. Let me know if you'd like to set up a quick call.
>
> Best,
> Sam

I added the offer to talk through what's possible on a two-year term. Cut that line if you don't want to suggest any discount. If you'd like to name a specific counteroffer, tell me the number and I'll update the draft.

input.subject: Re: Renewal pricing
input.body:
Hi Marco,

Thanks for getting back to me, and I'm glad you're thinking about a two-year commitment.

Unfortunately we can't offer 20% off. I'm happy to talk through what we can do on a two-year term, though. Let me know if you'd like to set up a quick call.

Best,
Sam
